title: Textida grammar, format version 1
description: Rules are tried at every position of a line at once: the leftmost match wins, on a tie the rule listed first. Tokens are the runs a rule names; text no rule names is plain. A region (begin/end) keeps its state across lines when multiline is true and ends at the end of the line otherwise.

formatVersion.description: Version of this file format. A reader rejects a version it does not know.

id.description: Name other grammars use in include and embed.

extensions.description: File name endings that select this grammar; the longest match wins.

fileNames.description: Exact file names that select this grammar.

firstLine.description: Regular expression a first line must match to select this grammar for a file without a known extension.

caseSensitive.description: Applies to every pattern and keyword of the grammar unless a keyword group overrides it.

wordPattern.description: What a word is for the keyword groups. Default: letters, digits and underscore, not starting with a digit.

keywords.description: Words that get a token kind when a { "words": true } rule matches them.

rules.description: Rules at the top level of the file.

kind.description: Token kind, dotted lower case (comment, comment.doc, string.escape).

match.description: Regular expression (.NET syntax) for a token inside one line.

words.description: Matches a word and gives it the kind of its keyword group; a word in no group is plain.

operators.description: Literal operators; the longest is tried first. Kind defaults to operator.

include.description: #name: a repository entry of this grammar; id: the top-level rules of another grammar; id#name: a repository entry of another grammar.

begin.description: Regular expression that opens a region; it must consume at least one character.

end.description: Regular expression that closes the region. May be zero-width (a lookahead) to leave the delimiter to the outer rules.

token.description: Kind of the match, or of the text of a region.

beginToken.description: Kind of the begin delimiter; default token.

endToken.description: Kind of the end delimiter; default token.

multiline.description: The region goes on at the next line when it is not closed; otherwise it ends with the line.

rules.description: Rules that apply inside the region, before those of an embedded grammar.

embed.description: Id of a grammar whose top-level rules also apply inside the region (CSS in a style element).

name.description: Name of the region in the line state.
